questions.question_text:
Caselet -1: EcoNow
The Launch of the EcoNow Campaign
As part of their corporate social responsibility initiatives, GreenEarth Corp., a global leader in renewable energy, has decided to launch a campaign called ‘EcoNow’. It is an innovative and new initiative by GreenEarth Corp.
The ‘EcoNow’ campaign, which aims to raising awareness about reducing carbon footprints, will be launched next month. The campaign will be rolled out through various media channels, including television, social media and print advertisements.
The marketing team at GreenEarth is tasked with creating a compelling narrative that resonates with a diverse audience. They need to ensure that the campaign’s message is clear, engaging and free of any grammatical errors. The success of the campaign depends on its reach engagement and most importantly the clarity of its message. Additionally, the team must carefully select words and phrases that appeal to both environmentally conscious consumers and potential business partners. With a strict deadline approaching, the team is finalizing the content and preparing for the campaign launch.
questions.explanation: Shared passage for the questions that follow.

questions.question_text:
Identify the type of grammatical error in the following statement from the caselet:

Statement: The ‘EcoNow’ campaign, which aims to raising awareness about reducing carbon footprints, will be launched next month.

options.A: Error in capitalization of a noun.
options.B: Error in the construction of the sentence.
options.C: Error in usage of the conventionally accepted form of time.
options.D: Error in using the correct punctuation marks.

questions.explanation: The error is in sentence construction because 'aims to raising' uses an incorrect verb form; it should use the infinitive 'to raise'.

questions.question_text:
The team drafted the following statement for a social media post. What is grammatically wrong with this sentence? Choose your answer from the options given after the statement.

Statement: By adopting sustainable practices, not only will you help the environment, but also reducing your energy costs.

options.A: The statement needs to be corrected for the use of the conjunction.
options.B: The statement needs to be corrected for the use of the negative 'not'.
options.C: The statement needs to be corrected for the use of figures of speech.
options.D: The statement needs to be corrected for Parallelism.

questions.explanation: The sentence fails the rule of parallelism because the phrases following 'not only' and 'but also' do not share the same grammatical structure.

questions.question_text:
Choose a word to fill in the blank such that the meaning of the statement is closest to that expressed in the caselet.

Statement: The campaign's message must ________ both consumers and business partners alike.

options.A: aspire
options.B: appal
options.C: appraise
options.D: attract

questions.explanation: In marketing and campaign context, the goal is to 'attract' or draw interest from the target groups mentioned.

questions.question_text:
Identify the correct punctuation for the following statement from the caselet. Choose your answer from the options given after the statement.

Statement: The success of the campaign depends on its reach engagement and most importantly the clarity of its message.

options.A: The success of the campaign depends on it's reach, engagement and most importantly, the clarity of it's message.
options.B: The success of the campaign depends on its reach, engagement, and most importantly, the clarity of its message.
options.C: The success of The Campaign depends on its reach engagement and, most importantly the clarity of its message.
options.D: The success of the campaign depends on its' reach, engagement and most importantly, the clarity of its' message.

questions.explanation: Option B correctly uses commas to separate items in a list and parenthetical expressions, while using the correct possessive form of 'its' (no apostrophe).

questions.question_text: From the statements that follow identify and choose one which would be most appropriate for inclusion in a formal media release announcing this campaign.

options.A: EcoNow is gonna be a game-changer in the way people think about the environment!
options.B: EcoNow is the coolest thing ever; everyone should get on board and change the environment forever!
options.C: EcoNow is expected to revolutionize public awareness about sustainable practices, positioning GreenEarth Corp. as a leader in environmental responsibility.
options.D: EcoNow will totally change how people view the environment.

questions.explanation: Option C uses professional tone and vocabulary suitable for business documents and media releases, unlike the other options which use informal or overly emotive language.

questions.question_text:
Identify the correct subject-verb agreement in the following statement. Choose your answer from the options given after the statement.

Statement: The marketing team, in conjunction with the project manager, ________ the content right now.

options.A: have finalising
options.B: is finalising
options.C: are finalising
options.D: were finalising

questions.explanation: When a singular subject is followed by a phrase like 'in conjunction with', the verb remains singular ('is') to agree with the main subject 'team'.

questions.question_text: The sentences given below are from or based on the caselet. Identify and select the sentence which contains a redundant word.

options.A: The marketing team at GreenEarth is tasked with creating a compelling narrative that resonates with a diverse audience.
options.B: This campaign will reach all sections of society through various media channels.
options.C: It (The EcoNow campaign) needs to send out a clear message that appeals to both consumers and business partners.
options.D: It (The EcoNow campaign) is an innovative and new initiative by GreenEarth Corp.

questions.explanation: In option D, 'innovative' and 'new' are redundant as they both convey the idea of being original or recently introduced, making one of the words unnecessary.

questions.question_text: Identify and choose the statement from those that follow, which conveys the main idea of the caselet in the most clear, concise and grammatically correct manner:

options.A: The campaign aims to raise awareness about reducing carbon footprint, which is crucial for environmental protection.
options.B: The campaign is aimed at raising awareness about the importance of reducing one's carbon footprint, which is an essential step in protecting the environment for future generations.
options.C: The campaign is aiming to raise awareness about how important it is to reduce your carbon footprint so that the environment can be protected in the future.
options.D: The campaign has the objective of raising awareness about the importance of carbon footprint reduction to help protect the environment in the long term.

questions.explanation: Option A summarizes the campaign's objective most effectively by avoiding redundant phrasing and maintaining structural conciseness as required in business writing.

questions.question_text:
Caselet -2: Accountancy
Poetry in a Sea of Commerce
The financial market is a turbulent sea, with investors navigating its waves like seasoned sailors. Stock prices fluctuate unpredictably, leaving even the sharpest minds bewildered. Amidst this chaos, the rise and fall of fortunes is a dramatic dance—swift, graceful, yet often ruthless.

Anwesha, a budding accountant with a razor-sharp focus, works under the tutelage of her high-profile mentor Dr Das. “Numbers, Anwesha are not just digits they are the very poetry of commerce,” says Dr Das, sharing his knowledge generously. However, Anwesha’s recent error, overlooking a crucial tax regulation, caused both of them much embarrassment.

Meanwhile, her colleague, Priya works with the precision of an ancient weather vane in a storm. Her calculations are flawless and meticulous each and every time. Dr Das always cites her work as the benchmark for young interns in the firm. Priya admitted that the art of accountancy wasn't merely about numbers but about seeing the invisible patterns they wove.

Errors aside, the world of finance remains a labyrinth, where only those with perseverance, foresight, and skill survive. It is a realm where concepts like trust and integrity shine brighter than gold.
questions.explanation: Shared passage for the questions that follow.

questions.question_text: Identify the simile used to describe investors in the caselet. Choose your answer from the options that follow.

options.A: They see the financial market as a turbulent sea.
options.B: The rise and fall of their fortunes is a dramatic dance.
options.C: They navigate its waves like seasoned sailors.
options.D: They understand the very poetry of commerce.

questions.explanation: A simile is a direct comparison using 'like' or 'as'. Here, 'like seasoned sailors' explicitly compares investors to sailors.

questions.question_text: Identify and select the closest antonym of the word ‘crucial’.

options.A: Trivial
options.B: Minor
options.C: Critical
options.D: Peripheral

questions.explanation: In the context of vocabulary building, 'crucial' means extremely important or vital. Its closest antonym is 'trivial,' which refers to something of little value or importance.

questions.question_text:
Correct the punctuation of the statement that follows. Choose your answer from the options given below.
Statement: He often reminds her, “Numbers, Anwesha are not just digits they are the very poetry of commerce.”

options.A: He often reminds her, "Numbers, Anwesha, are not just digits they are, the very poetry of commerce."
options.B: He often reminds her, "Numbers Anwesha, are not just digits, they, are the very poetry of commerce."
options.C: He often reminds her, 'Numbers, Anwesha, are not just digits; they are the very poetry of commerce.'
options.D: He often reminds her, "Numbers Anwesha, are not just digits; they are the very poetry of commerce."

questions.explanation: Correct punctuation requires commas to set off the direct address ('Anwesha') and a semicolon to join two related independent clauses within the quote.

questions.question_text:
Identify the abstract nouns from the given set of words. Base your answer on the usage of the words in the caselet. Choose your answers from the options that follow.
Words: invisible, perseverance, seasoned, integrity, flawless, swift, trust

options.A: perseverance, trust, integrity
options.B: invisible, seasoned, integrity
options.C: flawless, seasoned, swift
options.D: trust, flawless, perseverance

questions.explanation: Perseverance, trust, and integrity are abstract nouns as they represent intangible qualities or concepts that cannot be perceived by the five physical senses.

questions.question_text: Which figure of speech does ‘poetry of commerce’ represent in the caselet? Choose your answers from the options that follow.

options.A: Simile
options.B: Personification
options.C: Alliteration
options.D: Metaphor

questions.explanation: The phrase 'poetry of commerce' is a metaphor because it makes an implicit comparison between financial numbers and poetry without using words like 'as' or 'like'.

questions.question_text: Identify and select the option which is true for the statement 'Meanwhile, her colleague, Priya works with the precision of an ancient weather vane in a storm.'

options.A: The simile used in the statement supports with the facts that follow in the next few sentences.
options.B: The simile used in the statement contradicts the facts that follow in the next few sentences.
options.C: The metaphor used in the statement contradicts the facts that follow in the next few sentences.
options.D: The metaphor used in the statement supports the facts that follow in the next few sentences.

questions.explanation: The metaphor 'precision of an ancient weather vane in a storm' implies erratic behavior, which contradicts the following sentences describing Priya's work as 'flawless and meticulous.'

questions.question_text:
Read the following statement and then answer the question that follows. Choose one of the options given after the question.

Statement: A paragraph should have one central idea and subordinating ideas which help the main idea come to the fore.

options.A: Testimony
options.B: Coherence
options.C: Enumeration
options.D: Unity

questions.explanation: The concept defined—where a paragraph focuses on a single central idea—is known as paragraph unity.

questions.question_text:
Read the given statement and then fill in the blank with one of the given options such that the completed sentence is grammatically correct. Do not enter blanks/spaces, punctuation marks, numbers or special characters.
Statement: The business strategy was ______ a success because of detailed planning.

options.A: obviously,
options.B: surely,
options.C: clearly
options.D: hardly

questions.explanation: The adverb 'clearly' is used here to modify the status of the strategy's success, indicating it was evident due to the provided reason (detailed planning).

questions.question_text:
Is the statement that follows grammatically correct?

Statement: She has a deep understanding of finance, which is essential skill.

options.A: Yes, the sentence is grammatically correct.
options.B: No, the sentence is grammatically incorrect because "skill" requires the article "an" when singular.
options.C: No, the sentence is grammatically incorrect because "skill" should be plural.
options.D: No, the sentence is grammatically incorrect because "understanding" should be "understandings."

questions.explanation: The singular countable noun 'skill' is preceded by the adjective 'essential' (vowel sound), requiring the indefinite article 'an' for grammatical completeness.

questions.question_text:
Read the following paragraph and then identify the most appropriate main idea conveyed through it. Choose your answer from the options given below.

The Paragraph
Plastic pollution is a critical environmental issue affecting the world. Single-use plastics are major contributors to this problem. These plastics take hundreds of years to degrade and often end up harming marine life. Recycling efforts and bans on single-use plastics are being implemented in many countries to address the issue. However, global cooperation and public awareness are crucial to making a lasting impact.

options.A: Recycling efforts are being implemented worldwide to address plastic pollution.
options.B: Single-use plastics are convenient and used extensively but harmful to marine life.
options.C: Public awareness is the key to solving environmental issues.
options.D: Plastic pollution is a severe environmental problem that requires global action.

questions.explanation: The paragraph discusses the problem of plastic pollution and concludes that it requires broad, global solutions, making Option D the most accurate main idea.

questions.question_text:
Read the given sentences and fill in the blanks such that the subjects agree with their verbs.

Sentences: The series of seminars on advertising strategy ________ been well-received. Each seminar in the series ________ on a different aspect of advertising.

options.A: have, focuses
options.B: has, focus
options.C: has, focuses
options.D: have, focus

questions.explanation: 'Series' is a singular collective noun requiring 'has', and 'Each' is a singular indefinite pronoun requiring the singular verb 'focuses'.

questions.question_text: Read the following statements then identify and select the one that contains a coordinating conjunction from the options that follow.

options.A: After we analyse the feedback, we'll update the plan.
options.B: Unless the results improve, we cannot proceed with the next phase.
options.C: They submitted the proposal quickly, so they received a prompt response.
options.D: We conducted a survey to gather data on customer preferences.

questions.explanation: Option C contains 'so', which is a coordinating conjunction (FANBOYS) used to connect two independent clauses in a compound sentence.

questions.question_text:
Read the partially complete statement that follows. From the phrases that follow, select the one that completes it correctly.

Statement: A critique is...

options.A: a brief and informal opinion expressed casually.
options.B: a deep and objective analysis for experts with the objective to improve the content.
options.C: a personal interpretation of a work of art or literature.
options.D: a shallow and subjective recommendation made for the general public.

questions.explanation: A critique is defined as a formal, deep, and objective assessment or evaluation of a piece of work, often intended to drive improvement.

questions.question_text:
After reading the passage that follows, choose the correct answer from the options below to fill in the blank.

You pick up a book and read this on the back cover/jacket:

'In The Lord of the Rings, a young hobbit named Frodo Baggins embarks on an epic journey to destroy the One Ring, an ancient artifact of immense power that corrupts all who possess it. Joined by a diverse fellowship, he must face dark forces, perilous lands, and his own inner struggles to save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.'

This is an example of ___________:

options.A: A precis
options.B: A paraphrase
options.C: A blurb
options.D: An executive summary

questions.explanation: A blurb is a brief promotional description found on the back cover of a book designed to provide a hook and summarize the plot to attract readers.

questions.question_text: Read the given statements. Then identify and choose the sentence which demonstrates gender neutrality and formal language.

options.A: Every student is responsible for completing his or her assignments on time to ensure academic progress.
options.B: The applicant should submit their resume and cover letter by the deadline for consideration.
options.C: Each team member is encouraged to share his insights during the meeting to foster collaboration.
options.D: The manager welcomed all employees to the workshop, emphasizing the importance of their contributions.

questions.explanation: Option D uses plural forms ('employees', 'their') to achieve gender neutrality without awkward phrasing, following modern professional communication standards.

questions.question_text: Identify and choose the grammatically correct statement from the options given below.

options.A: The document needs to be signed by yourself.
options.B: The document needs to be signed by you.
options.C: The document needs to be signed by your self.
options.D: The document needs to be signed by your own self.

questions.explanation: The objective pronoun 'you' is appropriate here. Reflexive pronouns like 'yourself' are only used when the subject and object refer to the same person.

questions.question_text: Identify and choose the statement from amongst those that follow, which uses hyperbole to describe the financial implications of an accounting error.

options.A: The accountant's mistake caused the company's stock to plummet overnight.
options.B: One missing decimal nearly brought the entire corporation to its knees.
options.C: The audit revealed inconsistencies that required immediate attention.
options.D: The discrepancy in the balance sheet was a glaring red flag.

questions.explanation: The phrase 'brought the entire corporation to its knees' is hyperbole—an intentional exaggeration used to emphasize the magnitude of the error's impact.

questions.question_text: Read the following statements. Identify and select the one which is not ambiguous or does not confuse or mislead the reader.

options.A: The old lady saw the same strange ghostly figure with the telescope.
options.B: The teacher asked the student to bring her book.
options.C: We were caught off guard by a sudden cloudburst, which drenched us within minutes.
options.D: Walking through the park, the flowers were blooming brightly.

questions.explanation: Option C provides a clear, unambiguous narrative. The other options contain misplaced modifiers or ambiguous pronoun references that can confuse the reader.

questions.question_text: Identify and select the statement which does not apply to a ‘three tier essay’ from amongst those presented below.

options.A: Another name for a 'three-tier essay' is a 'hamburger essay'.
options.B: A 'three-tier essay' consists of one introductory paragraph, three body paragraphs and one concluding paragraph.
options.C: You are most likely to find a lot of 'three-tier essays' essays in literature as these essays can be very long.
options.D: A 'three-tier essay' format is popular for educational assignments as its format is just right and they can be written relatively quickly.

questions.explanation: Three-tier essays (5-paragraph essays) are basic structural models for academic training, whereas literature often involves much more complex and varied structures.

questions.question_text: Which sentence about Indian History is correctly written as per the rules of grammar and writing you have learnt? Identify and select one of the options below:

options.A: India gained independence in the first, Millenium ending British colonial rule.
options.B: India gained independence in the Twentieth Century, ending British colonial rule.
options.C: India gained independence in the 1900s, ending British colonial rule.
options.D: India gained independence in the nineteen, hundreds ending British colonial rule..

questions.explanation: Referencing the '1900s' is a standard, grammatically correct way to indicate the era, and the sentence structure follows proper punctuation rules.

questions.question_text:
Is the given statement true or false? Choose your answer from the given options.

Statement: The sentence ‘She has a deep understanding of finance, which is essential skill’ is grammatically correct.

options.A: FALSE
options.B: TRUE

questions.explanation: The statement is false because the singular countable noun phrase 'essential skill' is missing the necessary indefinite article 'an'.

questions.question_text:
Read and analyse the passage that follows and choose the most appropriate topic sentence from amongst the options presented.

Music trends often reflect the evolving culture and values of society. Genres like hip-hop and pop often highlight issues such as social justice, mental health, or personal identity, resonating with listeners’ lived experiences. The rise of independent artists and global collaborations mirrors the increasing accessibility and interconnectedness of the world. Meanwhile, streaming platforms like Spotify and YouTube are reshaping how music is discovered and consumed, prioritizing convenience and variety. Trends in music not only entertain but also provide insights into what matters most to people in a given era.

options.A: Electronic Beats: Dominating Today's Charts
options.B: Streaming Platforms: Changing the Music Landscape
options.C: Music Trends Often Reflect Society's Values
options.D: The Rise of Independent Artists in Modern Music

questions.explanation: Option C captures the overarching theme of the entire passage, which discusses various ways music trends act as mirrors for societal shifts.

questions.question_text:
Read the following statement and then choose the option from those presented to correctly complete the sentence.

Statement: We need ____ honesty to build strong relationships.

options.A: blank – no article is needed
options.B: a
options.C: an
options.D: the

questions.explanation: Honesty is an abstract noun used in a general sense in this sentence, which requires no article (zero article).

questions.question_text: In the sentence ‘The financial report was surprisingly accurate’, identify the correct adjective, the adverb, and the noun combination from the options given below.

options.A: Accurate (noun), Report (adjective), Surprisingly (verb)
options.B: Surprisingly (adverb), Financial (noun), Accurate (adjective)
options.C: Financial (adjective), Accurate (adverb), Report (noun)
options.D: Financial (adjective), Surprisingly (adverb), Report (noun).

questions.explanation: 'Financial' is an adjective modifying the noun 'Report', and 'surprisingly' is an adverb modifying the adjective 'accurate'.

questions.question_text:
Choose the word or phrase with the correct verb tense from the given options to properly fill in the blank in the sentence.

Sentence: The analysts ________ a downturn in the economy next quarter.

options.A: Having predicted
options.B: Predicting
options.C: Predicts
options.D: Predict

questions.explanation: Since the subject 'analysts' is plural, the plural verb 'predict' is required to maintain correct subject-verb agreement in the present tense.

questions.question_text: In the sentence ‘He is the CEO of the company’. What part of speech is ‘CEO’? Choose your answer from the options given below.

options.A: Verb
options.B: Adjective
options.C: Pronoun
options.D: Noun

questions.explanation: CEO is a naming word (noun) for a specific title or position within an organization, representing a person.

questions.question_text: Identify and chose the statement from amongst those presented that is not an Imperative Sentence.

options.A: Please, submit the draft for review.
options.B: Finish the report by end of day.
options.C: The file is in the drawer of the study table.
options.D: Read the guidelines carefully before starting.

questions.explanation: Option C is a declarative sentence that makes a statement of fact, while the other options give instructions or requests, which are imperative.

questions.question_text:
Read the statement that follows. Which one of the following inferences can be correctly arrived at from it?

Statement: For its quoted price, the smartphone is, not surprisingly, durable.

options.A: The smartphone's durability is unrelated to its price.
options.B: The smartphone is durable, as expected for its price.
options.C: The smartphone's price is surprisingly low for its level of durability.
options.D: The smartphone is not durable, which is surprising given its price.

questions.explanation: The phrase 'not surprisingly' suggests that the attribute (durability) matches expectations based on the stated condition (price).

questions.question_text:
Read the partially complete statement that follows. From the phrases that follow, select the one that completes it correctly.

Statement: When writing for international audiences, you should...

options.A: use thousands and millions for international clarity.
options.B: use Lakhs and Crores for a more concise and efficient representation of large numbers
options.C: use thousands and millions as only South Asia uses Lakhs and Crores.
options.D: use Lakhs and Crores as they are universally understood.

questions.explanation: For global intelligibility in business, units like thousands and millions are standard, whereas Lakhs and Crores are specific to South Asian contexts.

questions.question_text:
Read the partially complete statement that follows. From the options that follow, select the follow-on sentence that correctly describes where you will find these components.
Statement: Consider the following components of a business report: the appendix, index, and table of contents.
Follow-on Statement:

options.A: The appendix and index are trailing components, and the table of contents is a prefatory component.
options.B: The appendix and index are prefatory components, and the table of contents is a trailing component
options.C: All are part of the prefatory components.
options.D: All are part of the trailing components.

questions.explanation: In standard business documentation, the table of contents appears at the beginning (prefatory), while the appendix and index are placed at the end (trailing).

questions.question_text:
Read the partially complete statement that follows. From the phrases that follow, select the one that completes it correctly.

Statement: Proper nouns are...

options.A: sometimes capitalized and refer to general categories.
options.B: sometimes capitalized and refer to specific people, places, or things.
options.C: always capitalized and refer to specific people, places, or things.
options.D: always capitalized and refer to general categories.

questions.explanation: By definition, proper nouns designate specific, unique entities and are always capitalized in standard English grammar.

questions.question_text:
Read the partially complete statement that follows. From the phrases that follow, select the one that completes it correctly.

Statement: A topic sentence should...

options.A: introduce the main idea or argument of the paragraph that it is a part of.
options.B: conclude the main idea or argument of the paragraph that it is a part of.
options.C: provide evidence and support for the main idea of the paragraph that it is a part of.
options.D: summarize what is being said in the paragraph that it is a part of.

questions.explanation: As per paragraph structure (OBC model), the topic sentence's primary role is to introduce the main idea or central premise of the paragraph.
